entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf Planeswalker who returns to Bala Ged, confronts her old self, unleashes her wild essence, and restores Zendikar's soul by feeding Khalni Heart.

entities.name: Ashaya
entities.description: The elemental manifestation of Zendikar's soul, who returns to Nissa when Khalni Heart is restored.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The living world whose soul Nissa sought and finds in Khalni Heart.

entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: The flower expressing Zendikar's mana, where all leylines converge, which was uprooted and imprisoned by a demon.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Nissa's home continent, entirely consumed by Eldrazi corruption.

entities.name: The Tangled Vales
entities.description: A region of Bala Ged where Nissa once hunted.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Planeswalker whom the demon believes sent Nissa to stop him.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: The Planeswalker whose army Nissa will join at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Chief Numa
entities.description: The Joraga chief who led chants at Nissa's village.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monsters that consumed Bala Ged; one leads Nissa to the cave.

entities.name: The Joraga
entities.description: The tribe of elves Nissa grew up in.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city where Gideon's army gathers.

entities.name: The hedron prison
entities.description: A ring of hedrons with leylines in an unnatural pattern that held Khalni Heart captive.

entities.name: The surrakar
entities.description: Territorial reptilian beasts that once nested in the caves of Bala Ged.

events.summary: Nissa arrives on Bala Ged and finds it entirely consumed by white corruption.
events.quote: The land wasn't ruined—it had been entirely consumed.

events.summary: Nissa walks to the site of her old village and is overwhelmed by memories of her past self and her departure.
events.quote: She wouldn't be that elf again, she couldn't be.

events.summary: Nissa instinctively kills a gomazoa-like Eldrazi and realizes it must have fed on life, leading her toward Khalni Heart.
events.quote: She quartered the monstrosity so quickly

events.summary: Following the Eldrazi's trail to a surrakar cave, Nissa finds a moss-lined tunnel.
events.quote: she saw the first sign of life.

events.summary: Nissa finds a ring of hedrons imprisoning the wilted Khalni Heart and realizes someone uprooted Zendikar's soul.
events.quote: someone had uprooted the land's soul and trapped it here to die.

events.summary: A demon attacks Nissa, mistaking her for Nahiri's emissary, and they fight.
Nissa unleashes her wild essence to reflect the demon's life-draining blast.
events.quote: Suddenly, the full force of Nissa's essence came rushing back to her

events.summary: The demon reveals he plans to seize Khalni Heart's power, and Nissa breaks a hedron to open the prison.
Nissa touches Khalni Heart but the demon traps her and tells her to planeswalk away.
events.quote: "If you want to live, now is the time to planeswalk away."

events.summary: Nissa realizes she is neither her old self nor her controlled self and pours her essence into Khalni Heart, letting it root in the land.
events.quote: Nissa collected all the power left within her

events.summary: The land swallows Khalni Heart and Zendikar's soul returns to the land, defeating the demon's plan.
events.quote: The world's soul had returned to the land.

events.summary: Nissa drives a fist of land into the demon and rises with Ashaya, who returns as her friend.
events.quote: Nissa rose up, and so too did the world's soul, her friend.

events.summary: Nissa and Ashaya set off to return to Sea Gate and join Gideon's battle cry.
events.quote: Nissa and Ashaya would return to Sea Gate, they would meet Gideon's army

relations.quote: They were one, and also they were each their own

relations.note: The flower is the expression of Zendikar's mana where the world's soul retreats.
relations.quote: had come here to revive the land

relations.note: Dressed like a simple Joraga; she once lived in the village.
relations.quote: You're dressed like a simple Joraga.
while Chief Numa led the chants.

relations.note: She kills one on Bala Ged.
The new bloom grows on Bala Ged.
relations.quote: growing a new bud somewhere on this continent.
